title: MUSCLE MANGA - The Giant of the Sea of Japan: Yoshinari's Physique in Kengan Ashura
summary: A short analysis of Kaoru Yoshinari from Kengan Ashura, a 6'8", 360 lb fisherman who combines durability, power, flexibility and balance built from 40 years at sea. NH praises his 'whale mode' mix of fat and muscle and his willingness to fight for his family and town.
claims: In real life, unlike fighting games, heavyweights often have both durability and power, which is why weight classes exist
Yoshinari stands 6'8" and weighs 360 lb, built from 40 years of fishing rather than dojo training
A mix of high body fat and lean mass on a giant creates visible ridges on the back and limbs; NH calls it 'whale mode', beyond bear mode
A man with something precious to protect, like his family and community, becomes far more dangerous
